newsitem.title: UK: HSBC makes London research appointment.
newsitem.headline: HSBC makes London research appointment.

text.p: HSBC Midland said on Monday it announced two new appointments to its research department in London.

Karl Bergqwist has been appointed assistant director, credit research. He will head a team of credit analysts servicing the international debt securities business, which is marketed under the name HSBC Markets.
Bergqwist was formerly joint deputy head of the credit rating unit at NatWest Markets and previously worked at Moody's in New York and London.

Ros Lifton has been appointed senior international economist and will be primarily responsible for coverage of the German and Italian markets. She was formerly senior European economist with Daiwa Europe.
Both will report to Mark Cliffe, chief international economist, HSBC said in a statement.
Cliffe aims to make further appointments to expand the department's foreign exchange and fixed income research, HSBC added.
